newsitem.title: NORWAY: Orkla's Abba sells German activities.
newsitem.headline: Orkla's Abba sells German activities.

text.p: Food-based conglomerate Orkla ASA said on Monday its Abba Seafoods division had sold its operations in Germany and two factories in Denmark.
The sale formed part of a programme to improve the profitability of Abba, Orkla said in a statement to the Oslo bourse.
The sales would reduce Abba's annual turnover to 1.43 billion Swedish crowns from 1.75 billion crowns in 1995.
"The reason for the sale is last year's weak profitability for Abba Seafood in Germany and in parts of the group's Danish activities," the statement said.
Abba sold manufacturing plants at Loegstoer and Fredrikshavn to Larsen of Denmark.
Orkla said Abba would increase focus on its Nordic core activities, and concentrate on product development and increasing production efficiency.
